title: Any APPLICABLE one of the six M&A validators missing at DD exit
thresholds_source: docs/decisions/2026-08-24-class-c-decisions.md (gd-0024-class-c-decisions); var seeded by migration 0027 per ADR-0064 + any_of_six_ma_validators_missing_at_dd_exit wording (ADR-0060)
notes: Scope is APPLICABLE validators (ADR-0048): all six are declared for every project; a validator the applicability registry does not apply is covered-with-reason via a live not_applicable compliance_check row and is NOT missing. The 3-number record (6 declared / N applicable / M completed) is computed by db/lib/validator-completeness.ts (migration 0016). Still declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). No waiver path: completeness check, not judgment (design section 8.9-1(f)). Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: validators.applicable_missing (count, computed by the validator-completeness engine in db/lib/validator-completeness.ts, which exposes no snapshot var today; threshold >=1 decided by the criterion wording). ADR-0064 arms this: validators.applicable_missing mirrors validator-completeness.ts's own halt set (applicable-and-missing only; live not_applicable rows never count) as a snapshot var — threshold >=1 decided by the criterion wording.
